name: Nathan Graves (Circle of the Moon)
summary: Nathan Graves as a 12th playable character: a rebased copy of Simon (8-bit)'s code module, the Hunter Whip, and CotM's Dual Set-up System with 20 cards and all 100 pairs.
state: Playable; all 100 DSS pairs have code paths, many still await a play check (docs/NATHAN_RELEASE_CHECKLIST.md). Online DSS harness-tested only. No player installer yet.

features.runtime_switch: hod_native_mods.txt or package 17 listed in dlc_packages.txt (module code loads only from the package)

depends: core (Enchanted-row card icon, hurt-box feed for DSS targeting)
official DLC: Simon (8-bit), as the source of his code module

contents: data/player/dllTest12.dll (Simon's dllSimon.dll rebased to 0x836C0000 by xexrebase.py, patched per data/nathan_module_patches.json)
data/player/player_test12.def (ID 12, internal name Test12, DSS cards as the collection list, mode 1)
data/item/weaponset_dlc17.dat (Hunter Whip WEPN 0x91 and the DSS whips from 0x92; mask 0x800)
data/item/soulset_dlc17.dat (20 card rows, souls 90-110: 10 Action Cards in RB, 10 Attribute Cards in Enchanted)
data/opd/player/nathan/ (body sprite, DSS layers and effects, from the CotM ROM)
data/opd/weapon/wp/p_wpf0-2.opd, f_wpf0.csr, c_wpf0.col (invisible whip sprites with fitted hitboxes)
data/menu/chara_SEL11, g_face11, ui_chara11, ui_face11.dds (menu art; the portrait is hand-made, art/menu)
data/item/icon/icon17_*.dds (all four icon sheets; card icon in sub cell 80)
data/sound/VX_NATHN, VXJ_NATHN (.xsb/.xwb, rendered from CotM; about 5.1 MB of the 16 MB sound heap)

edits_outside_package.change: Nathan's permission bit 0x800 on hunter armour and accessories

edits_outside_package.owner: base game (the game reads Martial Arts from the base table only)

edits_outside_package.change: Card drops in free item slots (2.5%, Cockatrice 0.5%), so the Compendium lists them

edits_outside_package.file: stage00_00/01/02/05/07/08_set_hard.dat (base); stage00_03 (DLC 02), stage00_04 (DLC 01), stage00_09 (DLC 03), stage00_10 (DLC 04), stage00_11 (DLC 07)
edits_outside_package.change: Saturn, Unicorn, Uranus, Black Dog and Pluto cards appended last in the Hard boss chests

native.own_overrides: 17 in the exe (each passes to the game when the switch is off, and checks Nathan's player vtable before changing anything) and 16 in dllTest12; see docs/HOOKS.md
shared_hooks: kOwnerDraw 10 (palette scope around the whole draw)

claims.player_extension: 8192 bytes: projectile pool +1728, pair level +1580, network queue +7744, hurt-table pointer +8176

user_inputs: Simon (8-bit) DLC in the setup's DLC folder
tests: python mods/nathan/tools/verify_nathan_dss.py (26,323 native checks; 3 failures predate the hub, see README)
